title: Club Membership: recurring dues, enrollment fee, and annual facility fee basis
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which Club Membership bills its three tier-based charges: the recurring monthly dues, the one-time enrollment fee, and the annual facility fee.

## Rule
Each billing cycle the member is charged their tier's own monthly dues amount as a recurring dues charge. At activation, the member is additionally charged the tier's own enrollment fee amount. Once per contract year, on the anniversary of the date the membership was opened, the member is charged the tier's own annual facility fee amount.

## Per-tier amounts
| Tier | Monthly dues | Enrollment fee (at activation) | Annual facility fee (per contract year) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | $29.99 | $49.00 | $44.00 |
| Student Metro Access | $24.99 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | $34.99 | $39.00 | $44.00 |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | $44.99 | $49.00 | $44.00 |
| Premier All-Access | $64.99 | $49.00 | $44.00 |
| Black Card All-Access | $99.99 | $49.00 | $0.00 |
| Founding Legacy Access | $39.99 | $0.00 | $0.00 |

## Eligibility: a dues charge requires an open contract
A dues charge may be written only while the membership contract exists and has not yet closed. This spans the applied state at signup through active, frozen, past due, and pending cancellation, since a final prorated charge may still be billed while a cancellation notice is pending; once the contract has reached the closed state, no further dues charge may be written against it. The system record of the membership contract's own current status is the authority for this check, correlated to the specific membership contract being billed.

## Points of judgement
A contract sitting in pending-cancellation status may still be billed a dues charge under this basis, since that pending-cancellation state is one of the states this eligibility spans; only closed contracts are excluded.
